preconditions.description: The number of shortest paths between vertex 1 and vertex 2 is at least 1 and at most 10^9.

postconditions.description: The number of vertexes n is at least 2 and at most 1000.
There is at least one path between vertex 1 and vertex 2.
The graph is undirected, so G_{ij} = G_{ji} for all i != j.
There are no self-loops, so G_{ii} = 'N' for all i.

postconditions.expression: The number of shortest paths between vertex 1 and vertex 2 is exactly k.
postconditions.description: The output graph must have exactly k shortest paths between vertex 1 and vertex 2.
